title: "Domain Practice (test page)"

/*
Template for a problem checker where the answer is an interval.
*/

## Try it: Domain of a Rational Function

Find the domain of $f(x) = \dfrac{1}{x - 3}$ and enter it in interval notation.

```{=html}

<div class="interval-checker mb-3">
  <label for="domain-answer-1" class="form-label">Answer:</label>
  <div class="input-group" style="max-width: 28em;">
    <input type="text" id="domain-answer-1" class="form-control"
           placeholder="e.g. [1, 2) U (3, 4)">
    <button id="check-btn-1" class="btn btn-primary">Check</button>
  </div>
  <p id="feedback-1" class="mt-2"></p>
</div>

<script type="module">
import { checkIntervalAnswer } from "/scripts/interval-checker.js";

document.getElementById("check-btn-1").addEventListener("click", () => {
  const input = document.getElementById("domain-answer-1").value;
  const result = checkIntervalAnswer(input, "(-inf, 3) U (3, inf)");
  const feedback = document.getElementById("feedback-1");

  feedback.className = "mt-2 " + (result.correct ? "text-success" : "text-danger");
  feedback.textContent = result.correct
    ? "✅ Correct!"
    : "❌ " + (result.error ?? "Not quite — check your answer.");
});
</script>
```
